description: Source acquisition tier registry for planning result, review, turnout, and method collection work. This classifies acquisition difficulty and scripting ROI; it does not replace loaded result or review data.

tierDefinitions.label: Tier 1 official export database
tierDefinitions.description: Official query or export database, usually CSV/XLS/XLSX capable. Best scripting ROI.

tierDefinitions.label: Tier 2 official dashboard endpoint
tierDefinitions.description: Official dashboard or ENR system with consistent JSON, XML, ZIP, or text endpoints.

tierDefinitions.label: Tier 3 sanctioned partial bulk data
tierDefinitions.description: State-sanctioned or official-adjacent bulk data that is useful but incomplete, delayed, or missing fields.

tierDefinitions.label: Tier 4 local scattershot
tierDefinitions.description: County or local sources that must be collected and stitched jurisdiction by jurisdiction.

tierDefinitions.label: Tier 5 inconsistent digital official data
tierDefinitions.description: Official digital data with inconsistent jurisdiction names, unusual aggregation, or significant human setup.

tierDefinitions.label: Tier 6 official hostile PDF
tierDefinitions.description: Official PDFs that need extraction/OCR and may include noisy or non-printing text.

tierDefinitions.label: Tier 7 scanned system printout
tierDefinitions.description: Scanned printouts from recognizable official systems. OCR may work but requires recurring human checks.

tierDefinitions.label: Tier 8 scanned handwritten
tierDefinitions.description: Scanned handwritten records. Lowest scripting ROI and highest manual review burden.

tierDefinitions.label: Unknown
tierDefinitions.description: Source path has not been classified yet.

states.caveats: U.S. House is district-based and candidate-specific, so Georgia directional screens are low-confidence advisory context rather than candidate-benefit findings. Of 2,684 nonzero presidential precinct review rows, 2,637 have comparable two-party U.S. House rows, 8 have one-sided House comparison coverage, and 39 precinct keys aggregate more than one House district and are excluded from down-ballot dropoff calculations. County presidential candidate rows sum 19 votes higher than the statewide presidential contest total in minor-party/other rows, and 17 zero-total precinct entries are omitted from review charts. Turnout remains EAC fallback and precinct geometry/admin evidence are not loaded. Historical rows are official county-level SOS media-export baselines for context only; the 2020 media export reports the original November general-election export total and should not be mixed with separate recount tables without reconciliation.
